image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white and blue steam iron resting vertically on its heel rest. The iron features a glossy white plastic body with a translucent blue water reservoir window. A grey power cord extends from the rear. The background is a soft-focus white fabric surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The grey vertical support (heel rest) appears to merge into the white body in a physically ambiguous way. The connection point lacks clear mechanical definition, appearing slightly 'melted' or fused rather than hinged or screwed. The thickness of the support tapers unnaturally.

The internal components visible through the translucent blue plastic are indistinct and smudged. Real irons usually show clear water levels or internal tubing; here it looks like a vague dark shape without logical internal geometry.
The curve of the rear handle edge seems to warp slightly inconsistent with the rigid plastic material, suggesting minor generative warping.

To assess overall rendering quality, specifically looking for subtle texture inconsistencies in the plastic and fabric.
